provenance.sourceEndpoint: GET /openapi.json on the disposable pinned provider
provenance.selection: Catalog dependencies and explicitly classified alternatives in the household recipe extension, plus food GET/PUT/DELETE operations sharing substitution schemas; successful response bodies, request bodies, parameters and transitive local schema references.
provenance.projection: Omit documentation, examples, defaults and annotation-only flags. Retain validation facets and property names. This reviewed fixture is independent of immutable legacy compatibility captures; never update it automatically from live E2E.

limitations: Focused structural compatibility only; not all provider APIs or runtime behavior.
Defaults and cross-field/business validators are not checked; existing behavioral E2E remains required.
The comparator supports local refs, anyOf and the recorded validation facets; allOf, oneOf and conditional/intersection forms fail closed rather than being interpreted as equivalent.
